title: Private Soda Firing Service
bring: bisque fired work (up to 6 participants, 2-2.5 cubic feet each)
cost_text: $2,370 (subject to change annually based on fuel cost fluctuations)
how_to_join: Call 845-332-6585 or email absartorius@gmail.com to book; studio takes break December-January, scheduling for later winter/early spring
source_quote: Private Soda Firing: Oki Doki Studio offers private soda firing workshops in addition to our annual curriculum. These workshops can accommodate between one and six participants, with approximately 14 cubic feet of kiln space available.
summary: A private soda firing rental service for 1-6 participants with up to 2-2.5 cubic feet each. Includes preparation and glaze consultation; optional glaze mixing available for an additional fee. Contact studio to book around their firing schedule.
evidence_sentence: The private firing page describes customizable soda firing workshops where potters can tailor the firing process with access to the studio's glaze repertoire and additional consultation.
evidence_quote: One of the key benefits of a private soda firing workshop is the ability to tailor the firing process to achieve your desired results. When booking a private firing, you'll also have access to additional preparation and glaze consultation beyond the standard workshop level.
